title: Student V0.1 V5 authoring, Factory and source governance R1
purpose: Implement and qualify only R2 Handoff 2: explicit V5 authoring guidance, bounded learner-reference admission, governed supplemental authoring sources, and explicit V5 Factory admission reusing the existing exact source/kit/review binding.
invariants: Human R2 decision GO_PRE_PILOT_V5 remains authoritative and Handoff 1 is immutable input.
V5 is validated as learnit.kit.v5 and is never converted or disguised as V4 for Factory admission.
The promoted Factory build_context remains the sole sourceSetDigest/contextDigest/kit review-binding authority.
Learner references remain exactly {url,label,hook}; admission/source metadata stays external.
Role A is optional enrichment and cannot supply canonical claims required to solve or score an activity.
Role B exact bytes, authorization, provenance and claim mappings are required and the exact source set is Factory-bound.
Remote media remains rejected by the unchanged V5/V4 media authority.
No runtime/UI/Atlas reveal/V8/showcase/fan-in/promotion behavior is added.
requiredEvidence: Exact frozen V5 and V4 blob identities unchanged from the accepted Handoff-1 base.
Handoff-1 V5 canonical tests and V4 canonical regression remain PASS or are proven immutable from their qualified parent authority.
Deterministic no-public-network tests for bounded Role A/Role B Web admission and SSRF/redirect controls.
V5 Factory tests for zero hints/refs, progressive hints, answer leakage HOLD, Role A anti-orphan, Role B exact evidence and stale-review invalidation.
Exact source-byte drift changes sourceSetDigest/contextDigest and invalidates the old semantic review target.
Repository governance PASS on the exact final candidate head.
adversarialTests: Reject credential-bearing, HTTP, loopback, private, link-local, multicast and non-public destinations.
Reject HTTPS redirects to HTTP or non-public destinations and reject more than five redirects.
HOLD obvious 404/410, authentication-required, executable and download-only references.
HOLD missing/mismatched Role A admission evidence and Role B source-set/evidence mismatches.
HOLD a semantic review that marks hint answer leakage even if deterministic string leakage does not fire.
HOLD old review binding after exact kit-byte, learner-reference, or Role B source-byte drift.
nonGoals: 10C showcase port or final semantic acceptance.
Fan-in, merge, cherry-pick, promotion or student session.
Crawler, website mirror, archive service, persistent Web corpus or background link monitoring.
independentReview: V5 semantic review keeps the promoted clean-context independence firewall.
The V5 reviewer must explicitly assess hint progression, answer leakage, Role A usefulness/non-dependence and Role B claim/source consistency.
This Handoff does not perform final showcase semantic acceptance.
rollback: Close the unmerged draft PR and delete the reserved Handoff-2 branch; Handoff-1 remains the unchanged qualified parent.
